title: As bird flu ravages stocks, Kangaroo Island is 'sick of bloody disasters'
summary: Fears about bird flu's potentially devastating impact on South Australia's penguins have fuelled calls for the creatures to be vaccinated against the virus, with Kangaroo Island's mayor saying the local population has "taken a hammering" in recent years.
